description: collect_executable_input_constraints called incoming_executable_input_positions (an O(callers x callsites) scan with callsite-summary lookups) twice per callable input position -- once for the callable-input projection, once for the agreement branch. Compute it once and reuse; the projection clones the Vec for source recording, the agreement branch consumes it. Byte-identical.
title: Hoist redundant incoming-caller scan in input merge
